739e5b7ad0a3434793cdb72b1422265c.author: Miguel Bandera
739e5b7ad0a3434793cdb72b1422265c.description:
Edo-Tokyo Museum
Screen painting that depicts Edo before the Great Fire of Meireki in 1657. In addition to scenes of Edo, events such as the Kawagoe muchi-uchi and hawk-hunging and boar-hunting in the outskirts of Edo that were associated with the third shogun Tokugawa Iemitsu are portrayed. There are several theories as to the dating of the screen.
This orthophoto was generated from the model so the image can be show as the screen is fully extended.

0ad19c3d2acd419b87e6bef30388bcaf.author: mehelleproject
0ad19c3d2acd419b87e6bef30388bcaf.description:
An alley (dalan in Azerbaijani) connecting two larger streets in the Forshtat neighbor of Baku, Azerbaijan. Forshtat is an older central neighborhood in Baku focused more on pedestrian traffic over cars. These types of narrow alley's run throughout and are prime socializing spaces, especially in the summer where they remain cooler than other public spaces.

The model is imperfect, but I decided to leave it as is because I like the dreaminess of the look and the hints of the surrounding environment. A cleaner version of the model may come down the line as I improve at blender as well.

c47b7846fda245f9a26918e9804a4d0a.name: Parking Garage Intercom Pillar Scan
c47b7846fda245f9a26918e9804a4d0a.author: CLLFTVTV
c47b7846fda245f9a26918e9804a4d0a.description:
High-Fidelity Raw Scan (1M+ Tris) - Nanite Ready

A raw, high-poly photogrammetry scan of a concrete parking pillar or entrance column. The asset features a yellow reflective location sign ("514") and a mounted white plate containing an intercom/call box and a damaged access control housing.

The surface shows realistic water staining and urban grime. Ideal for populating parking structures, security checkpoints, or back-alley entrances in Unreal Engine 5.

Asset Details:

    Security Props: Vintage intercom button and broken card reader box.

    Signage: High-vis yellow column number.

da879c6609184e02b1cd314560e1f3cd.name: Chameleon Street Art Graffiti Scene
da879c6609184e02b1cd314560e1f3cd.author: MikieBoi
da879c6609184e02b1cd314560e1f3cd.description:
Scanned in street scene with textures and reasonable mesh. Use this as a dynamic backdrop for product placements, animations or parts of another street scene. The brickwork and stones on the wall and the pavement give it an atmospheric quality for modern and aesthetic compositions requiring a fresh take on street art.

Spotted the art in Leicester, UK in one of the back alleys leading through to the city's cafes. I think it captures something unique.

8a9422e2daf74c6e81ef25550d4591ae.name: Duke the Dog
8a9422e2daf74c6e81ef25550d4591ae.author: Brian Trepanier
8a9422e2daf74c6e81ef25550d4591ae.description: Beneath the golden glow of a jazz club’s vintage chandelier, an anthropomorphic Labrador retriever named Duke commanded the stage with nothing but a tuxedo, a weathered accordion, and a slow-burning cigar clenched between his teeth. The crowd hushed as his pawed fingers pressed and pulled with soul and precision, each note tumbling out like smoky confessions in a back alley. His tuxedo, slightly rumpled from years on the road, shimmered with the rhythm of the low, mournful wail of his instrument. a7412b18079a43bdaf15141362ba5c46.name: Porto Trams - End of the Line
a7412b18079a43bdaf15141362ba5c46.author: VirtualPhoto3D
a7412b18079a43bdaf15141362ba5c46.description:
The trams of Porto, Portugal—known locally as eléctricos—are a charming and historic way to explore the city of Porto. Once the backbone of public transport in Porto, these vintage trams now serve mainly as a nostalgic attraction for visitors. 

The heritage lines run along scenic routes, particularly Tram Line 1, which follows the Douro River from the city center to the seaside district of Foz (As pictured in the scan, the end of the line in Foz).
